text:
Type: extendable rectangular dining table
Use: dining, hosting extra guests; dining room, kitchen
Style: modern, minimalist, traditional
Materials: black-brown stained wood veneer, solid wood legs, pull-out extension leaves
Colors: black-brown, dark espresso
Shape: rectangular top with a deep apron and a visible extension seam, four straight square legs, solid and plain, medium visual weight
Feel: sturdy, calm, dark, versatile
Goes with: white or beige chairs, light walls, black or chrome accents; modern or classic family dining rooms
